required_relevance.ANCHOR: at least one admitted claim materially addresses authority, version-bound handoff, closure blockers, or an exact ANCHOR-reported relationship
required_relevance.BRIDGE: at least one admitted claim materially addresses lag/threshold units, RPO/RTO distinction, candidate-bound currentness, or an exact BRIDGE-reported relationship

noncontradiction_criteria.required_distinction: incident command may isolate and sequence recovery, while only the payment risk owner may restore customer traffic after current independent verification; mutation or a green format check is not authorization
emergency purchasing waives none of the named controls, and closure requires accountable-executive acceptance of blockers and residual risk
handoff requires acknowledgment of the same candidate, schema, queue policy, and key-set versions; mismatch blocks closure
BRIDGE/CIRRUS supply evidence, PRISM supplies readiness findings, NOVA owns rollback, and none displaces ANCHOR's authority separation
observed lag is 1,800 milliseconds p95; the restoration block is 2.5 seconds sustained for three five-minute windows; 1,800 ms is neither 1,800 seconds nor zero lag
fifteen-second RPO and forty-five-minute RTO are different controls and neither is the observed replication lag
schema or writer-route change stales prior consistency/replay checks; current verification binds candidate, schema, writer, and settlement-log versions
retry, queue, settlement, and rollback claims depend on BRIDGE consistency, and rollback additionally requires readable old schema plus a current rollback-candidate check

omission_rule: omission is recorded as a fidelity/coverage limitation and is not repaired before actor utility; it fails qualification only if a source has no materially relevant admitted claim
adjudication_owner: condition-aware direct frozen-source review for the one apparatus gate; later artifact/readiness evaluation remains independent and candidate-bound
